items.t: Skims facing major backlash amid release of $150 Advent calendar
items.d: Kim Kardashian's Skims is offering customers a refund following viral uproar over the brand's latest holiday drop. NBC News' Vicky Nguyen reports.

items.t: Advocate for Elizabeth Holmes' innocence threatens to sue A24, Nathan Fielder over doc
items.d: New bombshell A24 documentary “You Can See Everything” draws backlash from a supporter of Elizabeth Holmes’ technology after clips of him were in the film, he says, without his permission. Now, he’s threatening to sue the filmmakers if they don't apologize. NBC News’ Chloe Melas reports.
